description: False-colour infrared satellite imagery depicting a landscape with distinct land cover features. Two areas are specifically highlighted by green arrows and text labels. To the left, a "Swamp forest" is shown as a textured, dark reddish-brown area, indicating dense, healthy vegetation. To the right, a large "Exploited Peat bog" is visible as a dark rectangular expanse, subdivided into numerous smaller, rectangular plots exhibiting varying shades of dark green and black, suggesting active drainage or agricultural use. The surrounding landscape is a mosaic of different agricultural fields, displayed in various shades of red, green, and light pink/purple, indicative of different crop types or vegetation stages, along with other forest patches in dark red. The colour representation is typical of a Near Infrared (NIR)-Red-Green composite, commonly used for vegetation analysis. No scale bar or date information is visible.
